name: Electric Supply and Equipment Co.
old_description: Check out ES&E TV on YouTube! Find your favorite Automation Specialist providing product updates, tips, tricks and tools.
about:
Electric Supply and Equipment Co. (ES&E) is headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, with an additional location in Apex. The company operates as an electrical products distributor and solutions provider serving industrial and commercial customers across the region. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in the available sources.

The company stocks and sells a broad range of electrical and automation products from brands such as Rockwell Automation and Baldor. Its catalog spans motors, wiring connectors, safety equipment, communication and specialty I/O, fasteners, hardware, tapes, insulating products, and more. Beyond product distribution, ES&E offers value-added services including a ModCenter for modifications, Rockwell Automation training courses, modernization consulting, digital transformation and analytics support, and safety program assistance. The firm also runs an e-commerce platform for online ordering.

ES&E explicitly lists DataComm/TeleComm among its served industries. Its customer base includes manufacturing operations — evidenced by product examples such as Baldor motors for fans, pumps, conveyors, and compressors — as well as facilities seeking automation, safety, and modernization solutions. Training classes are held at both the Greensboro and Apex sites, indicating a hands-on engagement with local industrial clients.

The company promotes "The ES&E Way" as its guiding philosophy, emphasizing integrity, innovation, teamwork, and a customer-centric culture aimed at delivering the lowest total cost of ownership. It positions itself as a trusted electrical solutions partner rather than a simple reseller.
